title: Forward genetic screening in engineered colorectal cancer organoids identifies novel regulators of metastasis [crispr gRNA knockout screening 1]
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
model: Engineered APC/TRP53-KO KRAS-mutant colorectal organoids, orthotopic in vivo metastasis screen; Cancer-and-apoptosis library (1,570 genes, 750 safe non-targeting controls)
contrast: Metastasis vs primary tumor (8 primary vs 24 metastatic lesions)
paper_method: Recurrence of guides across independent lesions (MAGeCK); functional validation
paper_calls: Ctnna1 and Bcl2l13 validated as metastasis suppressors (loss promotes dissemination)
barcs_calls: 0-1 genes at FDR 0.10; clonal lesions, results descriptive
named_hits: Ctnna1 rank 316/903 (FDR 0.91), Bcl2l13 rank 812/903 (FDR 0.95) in met vs primary
verdict: Each metastatic lesion is a clonal outgrowth (top 1% of guides hold 99-100% of reads), so lesion-level clonal dominance violates BARCS's replicate-variance model; BARCS does not recover the paper's recurrence-based suppressors Ctnna1/Bcl2l13 at FDR, and the reanalysis is reported as descriptive confirmation that these counts are not analyzable as a conventional variance-based screen.
